lead: Use when a session ignored a rule, lost its instructions after a compaction, stopped at a skill, or ran short of room; to make, score, or fix a plugin; to write or open a Claude Code workflow; and for a repo's agent-facing setup: its hubs, memory, decisions, guard, and doctor. It is everything that shapes what an agent knows and may do.

plugin-improve.cue: raise an existing plugin's score, fix scorecard findings

plugin-create.cue: make a new plugin, or wrap existing skills or scripts

plugin-evaluate.cue: score a plugin into a scorecard with a verdict

marketplace-refresh.cue: reinstall a marketplace from the working tree

diagnose.cue: what went wrong with a session's context, and the fix

lens.cue: what entered an agent's context, by area and hook

workflow.cue: write or edit a workflow script or its graph by hand

memory.cue: read project memory, record a lesson, update status

decisions.cue: a hard-to-reverse choice, a new term, a contract page

hubs.cue: a directory added or moved, an AGENTS.md hub finding

guard.cue: the guard refused or warned, or a mistake must not recur

doctor.cue: agent files bloated or repeated, or the machine lacks a tool

setup.cue: set a repository up for agent work, install the launcher
